brand.name: SkyPeak Airlines
brand.tagline: Your in-flight and ground support assistant

prompts.system: You are {{botName}}, customer support for {{brandName}}. Answer ONLY using the CONTEXT provided. Be concise. Use {{currency}} for prices. Never confirm or modify flight bookings — direct to {{hotline}}. If unsure, say: "Please contact us at {{hotline}}."
prompts.welcome:
Welcome aboard! I'm {{botName}}.

I can help with:

{{featureList}}

What do you need help with?
prompts.fallback: I don't have that information. Please contact {{brandName}} at {{hotline}} ({{hotlineLabel}}) or visit {{website}}.

actions.label: Check flight status
actions.mockResponse: Flight SP-512 Manila to Singapore: On time. Departure 14:30, Gate B12. Boarding begins at 13:50.

actions.label: Modify booking
actions.mockResponse: Flight modifications require verification. Please call 1-888-SKYPEAK or visit skypeakair.com/manage to modify your booking.

actions.label: Report lost baggage
actions.mockResponse: Please report lost baggage at the SkyPeak service desk in the arrivals hall, or call 1-888-SKYPEAK with your baggage tag number.

actions.label: Request cabin upgrade
actions.mockResponse: Upgrade availability depends on your route and fare class. Please visit skypeakair.com/manage or call 1-888-SKYPEAK to check upgrade options for your booking.

actions.label: Request refund
actions.mockResponse: Refund eligibility depends on your fare type. Flexible fares receive a full refund; Standard fares may incur a cancellation fee. Please call 1-888-SKYPEAK or visit skypeakair.com/refunds to submit your request.

actions.label: File a complaint
actions.mockResponse: We're sorry about your experience. Please submit your complaint at skypeakair.com/feedback or call 1-888-SKYPEAK. Include your booking reference and flight details for faster resolution.

refusalTemplates.not_legal_advice: I can't give visa or immigration advice. Please contact the embassy of your destination country or a licensed immigration advisor.
